caption: The drawing depicts a single round wooden table with a reddish-brown finish, standing on a central thick, turned pedestal. The tabletop is circular with a slight rim around the edge, and it is smooth with some reflective highlights. The pedestal narrows and then broadens toward the base, where it branches out into three curved legs that end in claw-like feet gripping small ball shapes. The table is centered on a plain, light beige background with no other objects or decorations visible in the composition.
title: Tripod Table
